component.name: Doom Launcher
component.summary: Doom frontend and wad library for Linux

description.p: Doom Launcher is a library for Doom engine games and mods. On Linux it uses GTK 4 and libadwaita. It can detect GZDoom as a native binary or Flatpak, import IWADs, and download mods from idgames, GitHub, Romero Games, and other community sites.
